name: GPU-Steered LRU Cache Management
aliases: Combining Rendering and Visibility (LRU Cache Management)
Unified Management of Brick and Node Pool
definition: A method where the GPU steers data loading by indicating which nodes were helpful, using spatial and temporal coherence to update an LRU cache on the CPU without significant overhead.
summary: GPU-Steered LRU Cache Management unifies brick and node pool management by having the GPU steer CPU data loading, eliminating CPU-driven visibility queries.
